answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 149724 Country: India Title: Purity of stored water while performing ghusl. Question: I was performing fardh ghusl. When I was applying soap on my legs, incidentally some jhag (foam) went in bucket full of water. My question is: does this going of foam into water bucket makes whole water napaak (impure) or not? Answer ID: 149724 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 762/730/SN=7/1438) The status of impurity in janabah is not Haqiqi rather it is Hukmi. Hence if at the time taking of janabah ghusl i.e. fardh ghusl - the water touched with the body or foam of the soap falls in the water or smears with the clothes then the cloth and water does not turn impure provided the falling water or foam is free from visible impurity i.e. semen etc. So in the question mentioned above if no visible impurity such as semen etc is mixed in the foam then the water in the bucket shall not turn impure rather it shall be deemed pure as usual. وإن انتفح من غسالة الجنب في الإناء لا يفسد الماء الخ. (كبيري، ص: 133، ط: دارالكتاب) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
